description: The Montreal Victoire are heading to their first Walter Cup final as they defeated the two-time defending champion Minnesota Frost 2-1 at Place Bell on Tuesday in the fifth and deciding game of their Professional Women's Hockey League semifinal.
title: Victoire outlast Frost to clinch series, setting up all-Canadian Walter Cup final with Charge

description: Sexual violence was systematic, widespread and integral to the Hamas-led Oct. 7 attacks and their aftermath, a new report by an Israeli non-profit has found.
title: Sexual violence was 'deliberate tactic' and integral to Hamas-led Oct. 7 attacks, report finds

description: After more than a decade of discussion and debate, polycystic ovary syndrome, or PCOS, will now be called polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome, or PMOS. It's hoped the name change will mean earlier diagnosis, an approach toward holistic treatments and more awareness of lesser known symptoms of the chronic hormonal disorder.
title: PCOS, which affects tens of millions of women, is now known as PMOS. Here's why the renaming is important

description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman took the witness stand Tuesday to defend his business record in a trial pitting him against Elon Musk, rebutting testimony that disparaged his leadership at a pivotal time for the ChatGPT maker. Musk, the world's richest man, is seeking Altman's ouster from the company leadership as part of a civil lawsuit accusing him of betraying their shared vision for OpenAI.
title: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman testifies in high-stakes court bout with Elon Musk

description: More Canadians are filing for insolvency according to the latest data from the Office of the Superintendent of Bankruptcy, as rising costs stretch consumers to their limits.
title: Are Canadians reaching their 'breaking point'? New data shows more people filing for insolvency

description: Russian forces launched attacks in Ukraine's Dnipropetrovsk region on ‌Tuesday, killing at least six people, regional officials said, after the expiry of a U.S.-mediated ceasefire.
title: Ukraine says Russia launches 200-plus drones in overnight attacks, leaving 6 dead

description: FBI Director Kash Patel angrily lashed out at a Democratic lawmaker at a budget hearing Tuesday, calling allegations that he drinks excessively on the job and that staff have found him unreachable at times "unequivocally, categorically false."
title: FBI Director Kash Patel clashes with senator over report of his excessive drinking

description: Pittsburgh Penguins captain Sidney Crosby will join the men's national team at the world championship in Switzerland, his NHL club and Hockey Canada announced Tuesday.
title: Canada's Sidney Crosby set to make 4th appearance at men's world hockey championship

description: Three Dawson Creek residents have received national honours for saving their friend and mother during a bear attack near the northeast B.C. city in 2022.
title: 3 B.C. residents receive national honours for courage, bravery after 2022 bear attack

description: The head of the U.S. Food and Drug Administration, Dr. Marty Makary, is resigning after a rocky tenure that drew months of complaints from health industry executives, anti-abortion activists, vaping lobbyists and other allies of U.S. President Donald Trump.
title: Marty Makary exits FDA amid mounting complaints, including from Trump allies

description: The 79th Cannes Film Festival has begun, kicking off two weeks of French Riviera frenzy with filmmakers and stars walking the red carpet for the opening ceremony and the screening of the film "The Electric Kiss," a French period comedy.
title: IN PHOTOS | Cannes Film Festival opening

description: The Eurovision Song Contest semifinals start on Tuesday. But Ireland, Spain, Slovenia, the Netherlands and Iceland will be absent. They've pulled out of the competition over Israel's continuing participation.
title: Eurovision 2026 is here, but some countries won't be taking the stage

description: A French woman infected in the deadly hantavirus outbreak on a cruise ship is critically ill and being treated with an artificial lung, a doctor at the Paris hospital caring for the sickened passenger said Tuesday.
title: French woman with hantavirus has severe form of disease, is in 'final stage of supportive care'

description: Brandon Clarke, a forward for the Memphis Grizzlies, has died at the age of 29.
title: Memphis Grizzlies forward Brandon Clarke dead at 29

description: Citing the city’s high concentration of bank headquarters and financial services, Ontario leaders are arguing that Toronto’s the only viable choice for the new multinational Defence, Security and Resilience Bank.
title: Toronto is 'only city' that can host new international defence bank: Ford

description: A wildfire threatening homes near Whitecourt continues to rage a few kilometres southeast of the northern Alberta town.
title: 'Raining down ash': Fast-moving wildfire continues to rage near Whitecourt, Alta.

description: In a country dominated by Tim Hortons, will anyone run to Dunkin’? Montreal-based restaurant operator Foodtastic thinks so, and plans to bring hundreds of the doughnut shops to Canada as early as this year.
title: Dunkin' coming back to Canada, following deal with Foodtastic

description: The U.S. Justice Department said on Tuesday a grand jury indicted two foreign operators and a shoreside superintendent in the March 2024 collision of the 984-foot cargo ‌ship Dali that destroyed Baltimore’s Francis Scott Key Bridge and killed six construction workers.
title: U.S. indicts 2 companies, ship employee for deadly 2024 Baltimore bridge collapse

description: From slower speed limits to using technology to detect whales, B.C. Ferries is looking to reduce vessel collisions with whales as experts call for more education and research.
title: B.C. Ferries ramping up protection for whales with slower speeds, detection cameras

description: Suckerfish, it turns out, are not always the most considerate travel companions to their manta ray hosts.
title: Suckerfish are diving headfirst into unsuspecting manta rays' rear-ends

description: GameStop CEO Ryan Cohen has argued that by combining GameStop and eBay, he could cut costs and find synergies to create a much bigger enterprise. But analysts and investors had wondered whether the offer by GameStop, which is much smaller than the company its trying to buy, stood a chance.
title: Ebay rejects $56 billion US bid by GameStop, calling it 'neither credible nor attractive'

description: The province’s chief electoral officer says the province’s list of electors shouldn’t be shared with any political parties until the legislature makes changes to better protect Albertans’ personal information.
title: Alberta's chief electoral officer wants pause on sharing electors list until law amended

description: The 2026 FIFA World Cup is coming to Canada — and it's going to be the biggest in the competition's history. It's the first to be hosted in three countries — and Canada is hoping it'll also have its first-ever World Cup win.
title: What to know ahead of the FIFA World Cup

description: For more than 70 years, the Canadian Armed Forces have managed the avalanche control in Glacier National Park, alongside Parks Canada. That unique partnership is set to end in August 2027, when the Memorandum of Understanding expires.
title: Canadian Armed Forces to put away the big guns, end avalanche management in B.C.'s Rogers Pass.

description: Nova Scotia-born actor Elliot Page donated $25,000 for a well for people who live near Shelburne’s old garbage dump and fear contaminated water and higher cancer rates. The project has been fraught with delays, disagreement and division.
title: Elliot Page gave $25K for a community well in N.S. It's still not running and he's not happy

description: Between some provinces not selling American alcohol — part of the response to the trade war started by the U.S. — and consumers choosing not to buy it, the actions have been "devastating," says the CEO of the Distilled Spirits Council of the United States.
title: 'It has been devastating,' U.S. spirits group says about Canadian alcohol boycotts

description: British Prime Minister Keir Starmer will meet his top ministers on Tuesday for talks at which he may be forced to set out a timetable for his departure after one of the governing Labour Party's worst election defeats.
title: Britain's Starmer faces crucial cabinet meeting as calls grow for him to quit

description: British Prime Minister Keir Starmer defied calls to resign on Tuesday, telling ministers he would "get on with governing" despite a "destabilizing" 48 hours of growing calls to set out ​a timetable for his departure after an election drubbing.
title: British PM Starmer tells cabinet meeting he intends to remain leader despite calls to resign

description: As U.S. President Donald Trump travels to Beijing to meet with Chinese President Xi Jinping, the expectations around the highly anticipated summit between the leaders of the world’s two largest economies are being tempered by the war against Iran, and as China appears to hold some key leverage.
title: As Trump and Xi meet in Beijing, the biggest 'win' may be the summit itself

description: A new report submitted to the Quebec government says boys are "systemically disadvantaged" in their school system. Meanwhile, new Health Canada data shows higher rates of young men aged 15 to 24 suffer from mental health issues.
title: Boys are falling behind in school, and some experts say it starts in kindergarten

description: Public health officials have been clear that the hantavirus outbreak is not another COVID-19. But despite reassurances from experts in Canada and abroad that the vuris is not easily transmissible between humans, news of the passengers exposed on the MV Hondius cruise ship has triggered memories of the COVID-19 pandemic and fears of mass infections and lockdowns.
title: Hantavirus doesn't have 'pandemic potential,' says health official. Why those fears remain

description: A fast-tracked musical parody that transforms Heated Rivalry, the queer Canadian hockey romance, into an off-Broadway production complete with a "wine-mom" narrator and campy showtunes that creators hope will feed a fandom hungry for more.
title: Heated Rivalry is getting a musical parody the director calls a 'love letter' to hit Canadian series
